hookRows.body_you: A Capricorn Full Moon runs a little more somber and serious than most, and that is the point. Capricorn is the Mountain Goat, climbing slowly and surely toward the goal and dealing with whatever boulder is in the way. The emphasis falls on the balance between home and career, and between respecting your elders and living your own truth. Expect a maturity upgrade: more responsibility landing in your health, your home, your work, or your dealings with authority. If you have done the climb, this is the Moon where the hard work gets recognized. If you have been resisting a change out of fear, this Moon can force the growing up instead, and past actions may come back asking to be answered for. Ask what it’s actually measuring. Track your physical body, as well, because Capricorn carries unexpressed pressure in the bones and muscles. The main trap is tunnel vision. Feeling stuck is almost always a perspective error before it's an actual dead end.

hookRows.body_you:
An Aquarius New Moon is useful for changing the rules before the old arrangement becomes permanent. Saturn rules Aquarius, so the beginning needs more than a good idea. It needs a plan, clear responsibilities, and limits that everyone understands.

This may be the new group where one person is not expected to do all the organizing, the project with an actual budget and deadline, or the agreement that finally says what happens when someone does not follow through. Aquarius thinks beyond the immediate moment. It looks at the structure and asks if people can still live with it six months from now.

The caution is distance. Stepping back can help you see the pattern, but it can also become a way to avoid participating. Do not build a future you only want to advise from the sidelines. Choose one change that requires your time, your presence, and your share of the responsibility.

hookRows.body_you: A Pisces New Moon plants seeds in the dream. Set intentions about your inner life: the creative work waiting in you, the intuition you want to trust more, the connection to something larger than the daily grind. Pay attention to your dreams during this Moon and write them down, because the unconscious does real work here. Let yourself be vulnerable with your feelings, alone or with someone trusted, and plant the artistic project that keeps resurfacing. The caution is the fog. Dreaming is the gift, dissolving is the risk, so tie each Pisces intention to one concrete act in the waking world.
